home.lead: Pick a game and train your brain. Free, no ads, no sign-up: memory, attention and mental math.

math.title: Quick Math
math.desc: Solve problems as fast as you can — difficulty grows on its own.

memory.title: Find the Pairs
memory.desc: Flip cards and match identical ones. Trains memory.

stroop.title: Color & Word
stroop.desc: Tap the color the word is WRITTEN in. Trains attention.

constellations.title: Constellations
constellations.desc: Invent new combinations of 4 stars. No repeats — a repeat resets your streak!

numbers.title: Remember the Numbers
numbers.desc: Memorise the digits one by one and type them in order — trains memory.

parking.title: Parking Lot
parking.desc: Track the cars as they come and go, then say how many are still parked.

schulte.title: Schulte Table
schulte.desc: Find the numbers in order as fast as you can — trains attention.

shopping.title: Shopping List
shopping.desc: Memorize the items and their prices, then answer the question.

simon.title: Repeat the Sequence
simon.desc: Watch the flashing colors and repeat them — trains memory.

stopsignal.title: Stop Signal
stopsignal.desc: Tap the green arrows and hold back when a red hand appears.

stroop.hint: Tap the color the word is WRITTEN in

profile.title: My progress
profile.subtitle: Progress lives in this browser. Save it to a file to move to another device.
